subject: Clarifying level signals & debrief playbook for Senior Inference role
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Jenkins <recruiter@hirefast.io>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarifying level signals & debrief playbook for Senior Inference role

Team —

Thanks for jumping on this. We have a promising candidate (Priya N., sourced by Alex) coming through next week for the Senior Inference Engineer loop. Before interviews start I want us all aligned on the signals we expect at this level and a tight debrief process so decisions are consistent.

Ask: please review the attached draft rubric and the quick playbook below; reply with any missing signals or objections by EOD today. If no objections I will send a final doc and a calendar slot for a 30m pre-hire calibration.

Key scope / signals I think matter for this role:
- System design breadth: multi-stage inference pipelines, KV cache strategies, model serving trade-offs.
- Production impact: examples of shipped perf/latency wins and cost trade decisions.
- Ownership + cross-team collaboration: how they drive infra changes with product/infra teams.
- Code quality and debugging tactics for live systems (SLO triage, reproducible perf regressions).
- Level expectations: Senior should independently lead a non-trivial inference project end-to-end and mentor at least one IC.

Debrief playbook (proposal):
1) 10-min per-interviewer written score in the doc (0-4 for each anchor).
2) 15-min synchronous debrief on same day (canary debrief if a clear concern).
3) Bar-raiser (Marissa) gives final call where there's split feedback — we standardize on saying which signal is missing if decline.

Attachments: interview_rubric_v2.xlsx (draft), debrief-template.docx (template).

Thanks — Markus

--
Markus Klein
Head of Inference Platforms
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarifying level signals & debrief playbook for Senior Inference role

SGTM. A couple of quick additions to the signal list from interview-side perspective:
- Architectural depth: ability to reason about KV cache consistency and cold-start behaviors for long-context workloads.
- Modeling tradeoffs: when to choose quantized models vs fp16 and how to validate quality regressions post-quantization.
- Leadership: prioritization examples where they pushed back on product asks to preserve infra roadmaps.

On scoring: please standardize the meaning of a "3" vs "4" in the rubric (I often see drift between teams). My suggestion: 0 = no evidence, 1 = limited/needs coaching, 2 = meets expectation for mid, 3 = exceeds mid / borderline senior, 4 = clear senior with examples of independent impact.

I can prep two focused anchor questions for each interviewer (design, infra-debugging, tradeoffs) if useful — will post to the Drive doc.

— Lauren

Thanks Markus — I appreciate the clarity. A few operational items from the bar-raiser side:
- Please timebox interviews strictly (50m design, 40m systems, 30m hiring manager/soft skills). We need consistent coverage.
- I will act as bar-raiser for this loop; my role is to push on edge-cases (depth vs breadth) and call out missing cross-cutting evidence.
- We need one-line signal calls in the debrief (e.g., "has long-context strategy but lacks quantization validation examples"). That helps us document decisions for a later audit.

I've attached a one-page debrief-template I use that enforces the one-line signal call and a required concrete next-step on decline. Also adding the Greenhouse link for the req — please ensure interviewers fill scores in the doc before the synchronous debrief.

Attachments: debrief-template.docx (docx, 22KB)
